high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white photograph that appears to be historical in nature, likely from the mid-20th century. The text at the top of the image reads: "Wedding rings that were removed from Holocaust victims before they were executed, circa 1945." In the photograph, two individuals are shown handling a large quantity of wedding rings. They are seated on the ground, with their hands reaching into a wooden box filled with numerous silver-colored rings. The person on the left is wearing a jacket and boots, while the person on the right is also dressed in a jacket but without boots.
